title: EDGE-A1182 Faceoff Win 3v3 Reaction Game
source_text: 3v3 on faceoff circle. Team that wins the faceoff gets to play offense. Losing team's 2 wingers leave the zone to create 3-1 for winning team.
game_problem: Win the faceoff, recognize possession immediately, and convert the faceoff win into a quick numerical advantage.
representative_information: Faceoff result, possession, opponent release, teammate spacing, net.
player_decisions: Players react to who wins possession; winning team supports and attacks the 3v1, while the remaining defender protects the net area.
space_organization: Faceoff-circle small-area game with a nearby net; starts 3v3 at the draw and becomes 3v1 after the faceoff win.
goalie: SOURCE SHOWS NET; GOALIE NOT SPECIFIED
coach_notes: Use repeated live faceoff starts. Do not pre-call the play after the draw; the faceoff result is the trigger.
adaptation_text: Reset quickly after the scoring chance, defensive clear, or coach whistle so players repeatedly experience the faceoff-to-possession transition.
source_boundary: Core 3v3 faceoff rule and 3v1 conversion are source-derived. Quick-reset organization is Carolina EDGE adaptation.

title: EDGE-A194 2v2 with Rebounders
source_text: 2 rebounders per team and then play 2v2. Rebounders can only drive net after shot.
game_problem: Create and defend a scoring chance in 2v2, then react to the shot as additional players attack the rebound.
representative_information: 2v2 pressure, shot release, rebound location, net, rebounder timing.
player_decisions: 2v2 players decide how to create or deny the shot; rebounders read the shot and only then drive the net for second-chance possession.
space_organization: Small-area 2v2 with two rebounders assigned to each team around the playing area and a net at each end.
goalie: SOURCE SHOWS NETS; GOALIES NOT SPECIFIED
coach_notes: The shot is the constraint that releases the rebounders. Preserve that timing so players must transition from initial attack/defense to rebound play.
adaptation_text: Use short shifts and restart immediately after the rebound sequence ends so the shot-to-rebound read repeats frequently.
source_boundary: 2v2 structure, two rebounders per team and post-shot release are source-derived. Shift/restart guidance is Carolina EDGE adaptation.

title: EDGE-A170 2v2 Possession with Coach and Outside Support
source_text: 2v2 game - players must give back to coach when gaining possession. Use waiting players as support - you can pass to your teammates on the outside and get it back.
game_problem: Secure possession under pressure, connect through a reset outlet, and use outside support to keep the puck.
representative_information: Opponent pressure, coach outlet, outside support players, available passing lanes.
player_decisions: On possession gain, players must recognize and use the coach reset; after that they choose whether to use outside support or keep the puck inside.
space_organization: Small-area 2v2 with coach as mandatory reset outlet and waiting players available as outside support.
goalie: SOURCE FILENAME REFERENCES ONE GOALIE; GOALIE ROLE NOT DESCRIBED IN SOURCE TEXT
coach_notes: Keep the mandatory coach reset after a possession change; it creates a transition cue before players re-attack with support.
adaptation_text: Rotate outside support players frequently and keep restarts quick so support angles change and waiting time stays low.
source_boundary: Mandatory coach reset and outside-support rule are source-derived. Rotation/restart guidance is Carolina EDGE adaptation. Goalie role is not described in the visible source instructions.

title: EDGE-A254 3v3 Point Support Tip-Screen-Rebound Game
source_text: 3v3 game with point D always on offense. Can only score on tip, screen, or rebound.
game_problem: Use a point support player to create traffic and second-chance scoring at the net.
representative_information: Puck location, point support, defender coverage, shooting lane, net-front traffic, rebound location.
player_decisions: Offense decides when to use the point and how to create a tip, screen, or rebound chance; defenders manage puck pressure and net-front threats.
space_organization: Half-ice 3v3 with a point defenseman who always joins the team on offense.
goalie: ONE GOALIE PER SOURCE TITLE / DIAGRAM
coach_notes: Do not reward clean perimeter shots as goals; the scoring constraint should drive point use and net-front behavior.
adaptation_text: Keep shifts short and change the point support player regularly. Restart with possession in play rather than prescribing a point-shot sequence.
source_boundary: 3v3, always-offense point D, and tip/screen/rebound scoring constraint are source-derived. Shift/rotation/restart guidance is Carolina EDGE adaptation.
